ios.desc:
Struggling to stay consistent with your fitness goals? Training Cadence helps you build lasting workout habits with free workout plans, smart notifications, and progress metrics, powered by Apple Watch accountability.

STAY MOTIVATED & CONSISTENT
• Visual progress tracking keeps you motivated with weekly goals
• Smart notifications celebrate every workout completion
• Streak tracking and consistency scoring build lasting habits
• Never lose motivation with intelligent progress reminders

STRUCTURED PLANS THAT WORK
• Follow a training plan designed for real people with busy lives
• Start with beginner-friendly workouts and progress at your own pace
• Custom interval training breaks down intimidating workouts into manageable steps
• Schedule workouts directly to your Apple Watch - no excuses
• Flexible plans for your schedule and fitness level

ACCOUNTABILITY THAT ACTUALLY HELPS
• Apple Watch complications keep your goals visible all day
• Weekly progress widgets on your home screen maintain focus
• Smart reminders help you stay on track without being annoying
• Progress insights show exactly where you stand

DESIGNED FOR APPLE WATCH USERS
• Seamless workout scheduling from phone to wrist
• Real-time encouragement and progress updates
• Multiple watch face complications for constant motivation
• Automatic workout detection means nothing gets missed
• Works with all your favorite fitness apps through Apple Health

BUILD SUSTAINABLE HABITS
• Set realistic weekly time and distance targets
• Track consistency over perfection with smart metrics
• Seasonal analysis helps you understand your patterns
• Long-term trend tracking shows your real progress
• Privacy-focused - your data stays on your devices

SUPPORTED ACTIVITIES
Whether you're walking, running, cycling, swimming, doing yoga, or strength training - Training Cadence supports 50+ workout types through Apple Health integration.

TRAINING CADENCE+ PREMIUM
Stay even more motivated with premium features:
• Advanced insights and personalized recommendations
• Custom training plans for any size goal
• Advanced analytics to understand your motivation patterns

Ready to finally stick to your fitness goals? Start your 7-day free trial and discover what consistency feels like.

Privacy Policy: trainingcadence.com/privacy-policy

quotes.text:
I've been working on a fitness app. It's been a fun project on the side for a while, initially designed to help me keep track of my weekly hours or kilometres on my watch without shipping data to a cloud somewhere. This then grew (with me, as my training and goal did) to include all the other fun things like plans, graphs, notifications, etc.

The app tries to help build good habits - Encouraging and motivating users to achieve their goals.

https://apps.apple.com/au/app/training-cadence-workout-plan/id6475537588
